recorder_names.reason: Fresh installed-card, USB channel mode, native card-bank and input-selector inventory supplies stable capture identities and names. Physical local/AES50 capture banks and native AUX-input captures support reversible preparation of the inactive REC or PLAY banks, switching and guarded readback. Existing live card returns, including AUX-remapped card returns, reserve their USB lanes and remain routed. AUX physical remaps are returned only when their actual captures match the native first-six card-return lanes. Reconnect recovery reconstructs native selector guards without requiring USB-card eligibility or REC mode. Non-USB cards, processed/user feeds, active sources outside available capture/return lanes and X-LIVE SD playback remain explicitly unavailable. Exact-model hardware, audio-path and manual UI evidence are still needed.
